card.name: Inside words with rig, zig, fig
card.fires_on: The pieces "rig", "zig" and "fig" in the middle of a longer word, most often inside lamotrigine and Xofigo, and also in words like incorrigible and prefigured.

modes.description: The same pieces inside ordinary words or names such as incorrigible, prefigured and Danzig.
